items.title: Rinsed
items.author: Geoff White
items.review: I thought this was really well written and easy to get through, and I’d recommend it to anyone who wants a better understanding of modern money laundering and how fraud, crypto, and cybercrime all intersect. What made it especially eye-opening for me was seeing how sites like Backpage and Craigslist were used in sex trafficking, and how difficult it was for law enforcement to connect separate cases to the same offender when different agencies were each working only part of the picture. It was one of those books that makes you realize how much is happening behind the scenes that most people never fully think about.
